newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Phillips wins Venezuela La Vela oil contract.
newsitem.headline: Phillips wins Venezuela La Vela oil contract.

text.p: Sole bidders Phillips Petroleum Corp and Atlantic Richfield Corp offered $1 million Thursday for the contract to operate Venezuela's La Vela offshore oil field, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) said.
No other bidders were present for the sale on the fourth day of Venezuela's third oil round auctions. Total bids reached $1.5 billion in the first three days.
It is the second time operating rights for the 3,803 square km offshore field, discovered near the Falcon peninsula in northwestern Venezuela in 1972, have been sold.
Olympic Clayton Williams, who bid for the block in Venezuela's second round of oil auctions, had its license revoked after it failed to meet investment requirements. The field is currently inactive.
As a condition of the contract, the operator must invest at least $50 million within three years, although PDVSA expects investment to be higher.
A total of 131 companies are competing for 20 contracts to be sold this week with the winners determined purely by the size of their bids.
